name: x
js: const n=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].filter(d=>d.scrollHeight>d.clientHeight+8 && getComputedStyle(d).overflowY!=='visible')[0]; const c=n.firstElementChild; return {ch:n.clientHeight, sh:n.scrollHeight, snapType:getComputedStyle(n).scrollSnapType, pages:c?[...c.children].map(k=>[k.getBoundingClientRect().height, getComputedStyle(k).scrollSnapAlign]):[]}
